# googleworkspace_org_unit (Resource)

A Google Workspace organizational unit.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "googleworkspace_org_unit" "engineering" {
  name                 = "Engineering"
  parent_org_unit_path = "/"
  description          = "Engineering organizational unit"
}

# A nested org unit.
resource "googleworkspace_org_unit" "frontend" {
  name                 = "Frontend"
  parent_org_unit_path = googleworkspace_org_unit.engineering.org_unit_path
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the organizational unit (the final path component).
- `parent_org_unit_path` (String) Full path of the parent organizational unit, e.g. `/` for the root or `/Engineering`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the organizational unit.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Immutable organizational unit ID (the `id:...` value). Used for import.
- `org_unit_path` (String) Full path of this organizational unit.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Org units are imported by their immutable org unit ID (the "id:..." value),
# which you can find via the googleworkspace_org_unit data source or the Admin SDK.
terraform import googleworkspace_org_unit.engineering id:03ph8a2z0txipm8
```
